segments.snp5.3:1.4: Ko ubhantamabhiññāya, majjhe mantā na lippati [limpati (ka.)];
segments.snp5.3:1.6: Kaṃ brūsi mahāpurisoti, ko idha sibbinimaccagā”.
segments.snp5.3:2.4: Saṅkhāya nibbuto bhikkhu, tassa no santi iñjitā.
segments.snp5.3:3.3: Taṃ brūmi mahāpurisoti, so idha sibbinimaccagā”ti.

lines: Niṭṭhite pana ajitapañhe “kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ, maccurājā na passatī”ti (su. ni.1124; cūḷani. piṅgiyamāṇavapucchā 144) evaṃ mogharājā pucchituṃ ārabhi.
Taṃ “na tāvassa indriyāni paripākaṃ gatānī”ti ñatvā bhagavā “tiṭṭha tvaṃ, mogharāja, añño pucchatū”ti paṭikkhipi.
Tato tissametteyyo attano saṃsayaṃ pucchanto “kodhā”ti gāthamāha.
